info.name: TriloPlan Admin API
info.description:
Backend API surface for the Admin app — everything under `/admin/*` plus admin login. See CLAUDE.md, BACKEND_PLAN.md and BRD.md in the repo for full backend context.

Companion collections: `TriloPlan-Host.postman_collection.json` and `TriloPlan-User.postman_collection.json`.

## Prerequisite
An ADMIN account must already exist — `npm run db:seed-admin -- <phone> <email> <password>` (out-of-band provisioning; there is no admin signup flow by design). Set `adminEmail`/`adminPassword` below to match.

## OTP login while there's no real SMS yet
The backend has a dev-only bypass (`OTP_BYPASS_VERIFICATION=true` in the server's `.env`, off in production): `POST /auth/otp/verify` accepts ANY phone + ANY 6-digit code. Used here only for the Setup folder's throwaway host/user and the sub-admin's OTP login.

## Recommended run order (Collection Runner-safe, top to bottom)
Admin — Login & Sub-Admins → Setup — Test Host & User → KYC → Withdrawals (Admin) → Pricing & Economics Config → Users & Hosts → Moderation → Live & Broadcast Messages → Audit, Dashboard & Reconciliation.

request.description: The design's primary admin login method.
ADMIN-only, not delegable to another sub-admin.
Sub-admins/admins can also log in via phone+OTP (an additional path, not a replacement for email+password).
Takes effect on the sub-admin's very next request, not their next login.

item.name: 10. File a Report Against Test Host (for the Moderation folder)

request.description: "Submitted documents" review screen — every document on the latest pending attempt with a fresh 5-minute presigned view URL. documentType "audition_video" (the Live audition video step) should render as a video player, not an image, in the admin UI.
decision can also be "reject" with a rejectionReason. Approving also sets ageVerified when a dob is on file (BR-ACC-04).
Funds the test user first so the gift below can be sent.
Only meaningful if the withdrawal is still "pending" (i.e. beans requested exceeded the auto-approve threshold).
BR-COM-03 — a negotiated rate for one host (e.g. a top earner) without touching the global default.

processingFeePaise/tdsBasisPoints are new (Host app design follow-up's confirm-withdrawal fee breakdown) — min ₹1,000, max 2/week, ₹100 flat fee, 1% TDS matches the confirm-withdrawal screen's example.
Replaces the whole slab set at once (each row covers one [minBeans, maxBeans) range).

Which network carries 1:1 call audio/video. current: "agora" (per-minute billed), "p2p" (direct WebRTC + TURN relay, near-zero media cost) or "auto" (p2p for autoP2pPercent% of new calls, falling back to Agora mid-call if the direct connection fails). agoraKickOnEnd: ban the call's Agora channel when it ends. configs = full history, newest first. Nothing ever set = "agora" with everything else off.

exec: pm.test("current is agora, p2p or auto", function () { pm.expect(["agora", "p2p", "auto"]).to.include(pm.response.json().current); });
pm.test("has autoP2pPercent and agoraKickOnEnd", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.autoP2pPercent).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(j.agoraKickOnEnd).to.be.a("boolean"); });

request.description: Switch 1:1 calls between "agora", "p2p" and "auto". autoP2pPercent (0-100, "auto" only) = share of new calls that try p2p first; agoraKickOnEnd = ban each Agora call channel when the call ends (needs AGORA_CUSTOMER_ID/SECRET on the server). Both optional — left out, they keep their current value. Takes effect for the next call placed; ringing/ongoing calls keep their provider. Finance permission; audit-logged with the previous value. Body is the plain-Agora default here so running this collection never switches an environment over by accident — change it deliberately.

Which network carries live broadcasts: "agora" or "cloudflare" (Cloudflare Realtime SFU, billed per GB instead of per viewer-minute). agoraKickOnEnd: ban the broadcast's Agora channel when it ends. pauseHiddenVideo: viewer apps stop receiving video while hidden. configs = full history, newest first. Nothing ever set = "agora" with everything else off.

exec: pm.test("provider is agora or cloudflare", function () { pm.expect(["agora", "cloudflare"]).to.include(pm.response.json().provider); });

request.description: Switch live broadcasts between "agora" and "cloudflare" (needs CLOUDFLARE_REALTIME_APP_ID/SECRET on the server). agoraKickOnEnd and pauseHiddenVideo are optional — left out, they keep their current value. The provider applies to broadcasts started after this; running broadcasts keep theirs. Finance permission; audit-logged. Body is the plain-Agora default so running this collection never switches anything over by accident.

Connection quality the apps reported at the end of each call over the last `days` days (1-90, default 7), per provider: reports, connectedPercent, relayedPercent (p2p calls that needed the TURN relay), avgConnectMs, avgRttMs, avgPacketLossPercent, avgVideoKbps. autoCalls / fellBackToAgora = how many "auto" calls started on p2p and how many had to switch to Agora. Check this before raising autoP2pPercent. Finance permission.

item.name: Support (tickets + bot)
item.description: Host support chat — needs the 'moderation' admin permission. Step 1 opens a ticket as the setup test host so the rest has something to act on.

request.description: status open|in_progress|waiting_on_customer|resolved|closed|all, role user|host, category, q (subject, requester name or ticket id), needsAgent true|false, page/pageSize. Rows: flat ticket fields (id, subject, category, priority, status, role, requester, refs, assigneeId, needsAgent, handoffReason, summary...) plus the original { ticket, account }. Returns total/hasMore.
Sent to the ticket's owner live (support:message) or as a push. Audit-logged as support.reply. Clears needsAgent, and the bot never replies on this ticket again.
Any of { status: open|in_progress|waiting_on_customer|resolved|closed, priority: low|medium|high|urgent, assigneeId (an admin, or null) }. Audit-logged with before/after.
Tickets the bot handed over (ticket.handoffReason says why), newest activity first.
{ current: { enabled, model, maxRepliesPerTicket }, models: [...], configs: [history] }. Nothing ever set = off, claude-haiku-4-5, 6 replies.

model: claude-haiku-4-5 (cheapest) | claude-sonnet-5-5 | claude-opus-5-5. maxRepliesPerTicket 1-20 — after that many bot replies the ticket goes to a person. Takes effect for the next message. Moderation permission; audit-logged. Body keeps the bot off so running this collection never switches it on by accident.
{ articles: [{ id, title, content, audience: host|user|all, active, createdAt, updatedAt }] } — what the bot answers from.
audience: host (Host app tickets) | user (User app tickets) | all. active defaults to true; only active articles reach the bot. Audit-logged.
Any of title, content, audience, active. Fields left out keep their value. Audit-logged.
Same settings as /bot-config, flat: { enabled, model, maxRepliesPerTicket, models }.
Any of { enabled, model, maxRepliesPerTicket }; fields left out keep their value. Body keeps the bot off.
Same as /admin/support/kb.
204. Also at /admin/support/kb/:id. Audit-logged with the deleted article.

item.name: Calls (ops)
item.description: Admin Calls screens. Moderation permission. Lists take page/pageSize and return total/hasMore.

request.description: { calls: [...] } — calls ringing or in progress, newest first, with user/host names.

filter all|video|voice|missed; optional userId, hostId, q (call id, user name or host name), from/to (YYYY-MM-DD in tz, default Asia/Kolkata). Each row: id, type, status, endReason, userId/userName, hostId/hostName, startedAt, endedAt, durationSeconds, ratePerMinutePaiseSnapshot, totalAmountPaise, earnedPaise, durationQuality, createdAt.

exec: var c = pm.response.json().calls; if (c.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set("callId", c[0].id); }

request.description: One call, same fields as a history row. 400/404 when no call was found in step 2.

Ends a ringing or ongoing call for both people, like a hang-up, with endReason ended_by_admin. Billing is the same as a hang-up (every completed 10-second tick is charged). 409 if the call has already ended. Audit-logged with the reason.

status live|ended. { broadcasts: [{ id, title, status, hostId, hostName, startedAt, endedAt, viewerCount, peakViewerCount, giftBeans, commentsCount }] }. The older GET /admin/live-broadcasts still works.
Takes the host off air and tells viewers (live:ended). Audit-logged with the reason. 409 if it has already ended.
Optional context=call|live|chat, hostId, userId, from/to. Rows: id, giftId, giftName, pricePaise, beans, senderId/senderName, hostId/hostName, context, contextId, createdAt.
Host → user gift requests. Optional status=pending|accepted|declined, hostId. A request is accepted when the user next sends that host a gift, declined when the user declines it.

Optional role=user|host, type=SCREENSHOT_ATTEMPT|SCREEN_RECORDING_SUSPECTED|PAGE_HIDDEN|DEVTOOLS_OPENED, accountId, from/to. Returns events plus repeatOffenders (accounts with 3+ events within the same filters, most first). Events from before types existed show as SCREENSHOT_ATTEMPT.

item.name: User Wallet & Refunds (ops)
item.description: Finance permission. Every adjustment is audit-logged with before/after balance and the reason.

request.description: { balancePaise, transactions: [{ id, type: recharge|call|gift|message|refund|adjustment, amountPaise (signed), balanceAfterPaise, reference, reason, createdAt }], total, hasMore } — newest first.

amountPaise is signed: positive credits (a refund when reference is one of this user's call ids), negative corrects the balance down. reason is required (5+ characters). 422 if it would take the balance below ₹0. Adjustments are never deleted — fix a mistake with an opposite adjustment.

item.name: Host Performance (ops)
item.description: Analytics permission. from/to default to the last 14 days in tz (default Asia/Kolkata); at most 92 days.

request.description: { days: [{ date, earningsPaise, onlineSeconds, callsCount }] } — one row per day, zero days included.
{ onlineSeconds, earnings: { totalPaise, callsPaise, giftsPaise, livePaise, otherPaise }, calls: { received, answered, missed, rejected, avgCallSeconds }, quality: { bad, good, excellent } }.

item.name: Insights & App Settings (ops)
item.description: Insights: analytics permission. App settings: finance permission.

request.description: from/to default to the last 14 days. revenueSeries (per day: revenuePaise from calls + gifts + paid messages, callMinutes), callsByType, callsByStatus, missedRate, avgCallSeconds, hostsOnlineNow, topByOnlineTime (top 5).
{ dailyGoalSeconds, callQuality: { goodFromSeconds, excellentFromSeconds }, messagePrice: { minPaise, maxPaise }, liveCommentMaxLength }. Also on GET /config as appSettings (read-only, for the apps).

Same body as GET (+ optional reason). 422 unless every value is > 0, dailyGoalSeconds ≤ 86400, excellentFromSeconds > goodFromSeconds and maxPaise ≥ minPaise. Body here is the defaults, so running the collection changes nothing.
